subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should this issue define a durable workspace receipt contract for Excel/generic `input_file` uploads now, or wait for the broader provider-native document/file input contract?
rationale: Current code has partial chat upload support, but the remaining OpenResponses/generic binary behavior sets public API, storage, redaction, and security boundaries that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Approve durable receipts first
options.body: Add a narrow Gateway/OpenResponses file-receipt contract for allowlisted Excel/generic binaries with metadata and workspace/tool access, leaving provider-native forwarding and rich parsing to separate work.

options.title: Wait for provider-native contract
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the broader file/document content abstraction so workspace fallback, provider forwarding, and user-visible status share one design.

options.title: Keep extraction-only input_file
options.body: Document `input_file` as text/PDF extraction only and require users to stage unsupported binaries through other workspace upload paths.

recommendation.title: Approve durable receipts first
recommendation.body: Add a narrow Gateway/OpenResponses file-receipt contract for allowlisted Excel/generic binaries with metadata and workspace/tool access, leaving provider-native forwarding and rich parsing to separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision touches the media/input_file and document-extractor seams most recently maintained by this owner.
